sources: Official names, descriptions and grades as published for PlayStation 5 and listed identically by Exophase (GTA VI PSN trophy list) and PSNProfiles (trophy list 43531), cross-checked 2026-11-18; completion targets are the counts PlayStation tracks, as listed by PSNProfiles. Every guide below is written for this guide from the official description — no guide text is copied from any other guide.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to chase. Use the roadmap in this guide — story first, then stranger strands, collectibles and activities, then the 100% cleanup — and treat this as the finish line the tracker counts down to. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; this note is our own summary of the official description.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It pops as part of a normal playthrough — just follow the story markers from the start of the game and complete the mission's objectives. Nothing to prepare and nothing optional is involved. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Keep playing the main missions in order; the trophy lands when the chapter closes. Because the platinum roadmap runs the story first, this is one of the earliest trophies most players will earn. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2 — the name is shown exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Continue the main mission chain after Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. No side content is required for it. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Play the story missions in sequence and it unlocks as the chapter concludes. If you are following the roadmap, this sits in the story-first stage, well before any collectible cleanup. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Keep following the main mission chain; the trophy pops at the chapter's end and puts you one chapter closer to the finale. Before starting the endgame, the roadmap suggests sweeping up any missable-watch moments you have not yet seen. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for completing the final mission and finishing the campaign. Before you start the finale, keep a separate manual save: the official descriptions for a handful of other trophies mention choices and one-off moments, and a pre-finale save is cheap insurance while you mop those up. The trophy itself unlocks simply by seeing the story through. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Breakfast Run. It is earned by playing that named story mission to its end whenever it appears in the campaign — no optional objectives are attached to it in the official description. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing The Cartel Heist. Play the heist mission as the campaign presents it and finish its objectives; the trophy unlocks at the mission's conclusion. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Child's Play. Follow the story until this mission appears, play it through, and the trophy is yours — the official description asks for completion only. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Headliners. As with the other named-mission trophies, it unlocks by finishing that story mission when the campaign offers it. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing VCIA Takedown. Play the mission through during the campaign; completion is all the official description requires. Note that a separate free-roam trophy, Catch Me If You Can, also involves VCIA — do not confuse the two. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Operation Savage Glory. Finish the named story mission when it appears in the campaign and the trophy unlocks at its end. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold trophy for reaching 100% game completion — the long haul that sits behind almost everything else in this list. Work the in-game completion checklist category by category: story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and exploration all feed it. In the roadmap this belongs to the final cleanup stage, right before the platinum; use the counter here to mirror the percentage the game reports. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 250 stunts. This is a volume trophy, not a skill wall: stunt opportunities are scattered across Leonida, so bank them steadily while you travel between missions instead of grinding them all at the end. The counter in this guide tracks your running total toward the 250 PlayStation counts. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity at least once — PlayStation tracks 9 distinct activity types. You only need a single attempt at each, not a win, so sample activities as they unlock during the story and tick them off here. It pairs naturally with the roadmap's activities stage and feeds the 100% completion trophy. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for gold-medalling every Shooting Range challenge — 42 challenges in total, as PlayStation tracks them. Treat it as a practice trophy: learn each challenge's target pattern, retry freely, and let your accuracy improve across attempts rather than forcing all 42 in one sitting. The counter here counts challenges sitting at gold. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations in all. A win is required, not just a finish, so replay a course until its racing line feels routine before moving on; the locations can be cleared in any order as you uncover them. Track the locations you have won with the counter here. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add to the tally, so keep moving to fresh events rather than farming a favourite. Races unlock across the map as you play; the counter here tracks distinct wins toward the 20 PlayStation counts. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, enter it, and finish ahead of him — one win is enough. If fishing is new to you, treat the first attempts as practice for the challenge's timing; the trophy only cares about the win. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Any arcade cabinet you find in the world counts toward the single completion the description asks for, so pick whichever game you enjoy and see it through to its end. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand by completing his final mission. Stranger strands are chains: work each of Andy's missions as they appear until the chain ends, and this trophy marks the end of his line. It also feeds Strangers & Freaks, which counts completed strands. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand by completing his final mission. Follow Kenton's mission chain from its first appearance to its conclusion; the trophy unlocks at the end of the strand and counts toward the 8 strands Strangers & Freaks requires. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand by completing his final mission. Play Billy's chain of missions through to its last job; the trophy marks the strand complete and advances your count for Strangers & Freaks. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. A strand only counts when its whole chain is finished, so prioritise closing strands you have started — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a named finale trophy in this list — over opening new ones. The counter here tracks finished strands toward 8. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand by completing his final mission. Work Randy's chain whenever it is offered and this trophy closes the strand, adding one to your Strangers & Freaks total. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by completing his final mission. Play Tyrone's missions through to the end of the chain; the trophy unlocks at the finale and counts toward the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. This is an exploration sweep: use the counter here each time you use a spot so none is double-counted or missed, and pair the hunt with The Goodtime State, which asks you to explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The official description names no locations, so work area by area and let the counter be your checklist. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. Take the job from Bret, track the one-of-a-kind animal it names, and complete the hunt — the description asks for that specific hunt, not general hunting. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are found one at a time, so focus on finishing sets rather than scattering effort: pick the set closest to complete, hunt its remaining cards, and repeat until three sets are closed. The counter here tracks completed sets, not individual cards. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for using WAiNK at 100 different locations. Like the meditation spots, this rewards steady exploration over grinding: tag locations as your travels uncover them and let the counter here keep the running total PlayStation tracks toward 100. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges surface all over Leonida, so this usually falls out of varied play — sample new activities (which also serves Master of None) and the tally climbs on its own. Use the counter here to mirror your total toward 50. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While playing with your partner, build up a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely so you both escape the heat. Deliberately set it up in free roam: raise the wanted level together, break line of sight, and stay hidden until the stars clear. The trophy needs the escape, not the crime spree. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back in one unbroken wanted streak — losing the wanted level between shops breaks the run. Plan a tight route of three nearby shops before you start, move fast between them, and keep the heat on you the whole way. The counter here tracks the current streak. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Variety is the whole job: get into vehicles you have not driven before whenever you spot one, especially in new districts, and the discoveries accumulate quickly. The counter here tracks your distinct total toward 100. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up rather than hoping for it: pick a fight with at least five enemies in reach, position before you trigger Combat Focus, and work through them before the effect ends. If a run falls short, the next crowded fight is another attempt. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Watch: the description names one specific place, VCIA, and a departure that is 'unscheduled' — a scripted-feeling moment. If a story visit to VCIA is coming up, keep a manual save before it so you can retry the moment rather than replay to it.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in other words, leave the airport the unofficial way rather than through a normal exit. Because the description ties the moment to one named place, we flag it on the missable watch list: keep a save before story business at VCIA, and if the moment passes, reload and try the departure again. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; the watch flag is our own caution, reasoned from the wording of the official description.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke at the player's expense — Rhinos are tanks, and this trophy revolves around them. Expect to spend time in or against a Rhino tank until the trophy pops; the description pins down no count, so we claim none. When you next get access to a tank, stay in the action rather than abandoning it. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description, which is deliberately cryptic.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get through it without being detected. Stealth is the whole requirement: plan your entry and exit, move quietly, and if you are spotted, walk away and set up a fresh attempt rather than fighting through — a loud robbery does not count. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for robbing 5 bank vaults and escaping each time — a robbery only counts once you have got away, so plan the exit before you start the job. Space the five out across your playthrough and track them with the counter here. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. One truck and one clean getaway is all the description asks for: hit the truck, take what it carries, and lose the heat that follows. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas in total. Sweep the map region by region and use the counter here to mirror how many areas the game has registered; it pairs perfectly with the meditation-spot and WAiNK location hunts, which send you to the same far corners. Save it for the exploration stage of the roadmap and leave no grey patch unvisited. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in all, and it is one operation per gang, so variety matters more than volume. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit (the counter here tracks distinct gangs) and seek out the colours you are missing. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: Watch: the description describes one specific, quiet moment — a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Moments worded like this are easy to walk past, so visit Ocean Beach early and look for the opportunity rather than leaving it to the endgame.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — a small, specific moment rather than a challenge. Head to Ocean Beach, find where a drink with a view is on offer, and take it. We flag it on the missable watch list because the description names one exact spot and moment; doing it early, when you first reach the beach, removes any doubt. The name is shown with its ellipsis exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; the watch flag is our own caution, reasoned from the wording of the official description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: get into a car inside a showroom and drive out through the glass rather than using the door. The description asks for the dramatic exit, so make sure the car goes through the showroom front. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — the description's 'follow-through' points at actually playing a game there, name shown with its curly apostrophe as PlayStation publishes it. One visit to the named alley is the whole task, and it also samples an activity type for Master of None. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — is deliberately vague, and we will not invent a precise trigger it does not state. It points at something achieved together with your partner that draws a crowd's attention; when a partner activity starts gathering onlookers, lean into it. The honest note matters more than a guessed step: the description alone pins down no count or location. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description, which is deliberately cryptic.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Watch: the description is built on choices — 'for better or worse' implies decisions that stand. Keep rotating manual saves before big story decisions so a choice path can be revisited, and let the 500-count accumulate across your whole playthrough.
trophies.guide: A long-tail trophy built on making choices — PlayStation tracks the count all the way to 500, so this is earned across an entire playthrough rather than in one sitting. Make decisions whenever the game offers them instead of skipping optional interactions, and mirror your tally with the counter here. We flag it on the missable watch list because its wording ('for better or worse') is about decisions that stand; rotating manual saves before major choices is the safe way to play it. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; the watch flag is our own caution, reasoned from the wording of the official description.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Watch: 'Second time's the charm' only makes sense if a first attempt can fail — if you succeed at something first try everywhere, this may never trigger. If a repeatable attempt goes wrong, do not reload in frustration: try again immediately, because the retry is likely the point.
trophies.guide: The description — 'Second time's the charm' — describes succeeding on a retry after a first attempt went wrong. That is why it sits on our missable watch list: a player who reloads after every failure, or never fails at all, may never set it up. When something repeatable fails, attempt it again straight away instead of reloading. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; the watch flag is our own caution, reasoned from the wording of the official description.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Another deliberately cryptic description: 'What the hell just happened?' points at witnessing something strange out in Leonida. Explore off the beaten path, investigate odd sights and events when they appear, and stay curious — the trophy rewards the encounter itself. We claim no specific location, because the official description gives none. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description, which is deliberately cryptic.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee drive-by — striking someone with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, bowling them over as the name jokes. Line up a slow pass, swing as you go by, and make sure the hit connects from the vehicle rather than on foot. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder Marked Bills through your contacts until you have earned $250,000 from it. This is a money-over-time trophy: route marked bills through your contacts whenever you hold them instead of sitting on them, and track the laundered total with the counter here. It pairs with Treat Yo Self, its spending mirror image. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, cumulatively. Normal play gets much of the way there — vehicles, gear and garages all add up — so simply avoid hoarding cash and let the counter here mirror your shop spending toward the total. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total. Save your money with this in mind: garages are big-ticket buys, so prioritise them over splurges once you can afford them, and tick each purchase off with the counter here. The laundering and spending trophies (Dime on the Dollar, Treat Yo Self) keep the cash flowing while you save. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you get into a vehicle you intend to keep, register it before you move on; ten registrations accumulate quickly if you make it a habit, and it pairs with Whip It Good's 100 discovered vehicles. Track registrations with the counter here. Sources: official list (Exophase; PSNProfiles) for the name, description and grade, PSNProfiles for the tracked count; guide written for this entry from the official description.
